title: 7-Day Aegean Heritage Tour: Ephesus & Pamukkale
metaDescription: Travel from Istanbul into Turkey's Aegean region to discover Ephesus, Pamukkale and historic surroundings on a carefully planned seven-day journey.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
Turkey Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Small Group
summary:
The 7-Day Turkey Tour is built around four essential stops for first-time visitors: Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus and Pamukkale. Begin among Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine landmarks before heading to Cappadocia for its valleys, fairy chimneys and rock-cut settlements. The journey then turns west to ancient Ephesus and finishes at Pamukkale, where the white travertine terraces sit alongside the ruins of Hierapolis.
Available throughout the year, the tour can be arranged around your preferred dates. Selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers and the sightseeing listed in the itinerary are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Izmir & Ephesus Tour
itinerary.text:
At 04:00, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your morning flight to Izmir at 07:00.
Upon arrival at 08:10, meet your guide and continue to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman ancient cities in the world. Explore its marble streets, the magnificent Library of Celsus, and the impressive Great Theatre. The tour also includes visits to the sacred House of the Virgin Mary and the remains of the Temple of Artemis. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale Day Trip
itinerary.text:
After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” one of Turkey’s most remarkable natural wonders. Continue to the ancient city of Hierapolis and enjoy free time to swim at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies).
After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pergamon Tour & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: Breakfast and check out from the hotel. Drive to the ancient city of Pergamon, famous for its impressive Acropolis, steep hillside theater, and remarkable ruins overlooking the surrounding valley. Explore this important cultural and historical center of the ancient world. After the tour, transfer to Izmir Airport for your flight to Istanbul. Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Half day morning Bosphorus Cruise
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia on one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, return to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 1 Week Turkey Tour?
faqs.a: The 1 Week Turkey Tour covers Istanbul, Pergamon, Pamukkale, and Ephesus. You will explore Istanbul's world-famous landmarks, visit the ancient Acropolis of Pergamon, discover the stunning white terraces of Pamukkale, and walk through the remarkable ruins of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the Mediterranean. The tour runs for 6 nights and 7 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 1 Week Turkey Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,450 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this 7-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights help reduce travel time between destinations and allow you to spend more time exploring Turkey's cultural and historical treasures.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 6 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the itinerary are included.

faqs.q: Does the 1 Week Turkey Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural background, and local expertise throughout your journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience some of Turkey's most important historical and archaeological sites. It offers a balanced introduction to the country's rich heritage, ancient civilizations, and natural wonders.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Pergamon, Ephesus, and Pamukkale involve moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Pergamon, Ephesus, and Pamukkale?
faqs.a: Highlights include the impressive Acropolis of Pergamon, the Library of Celsus and Great Theatre in Ephesus, and Pamukkale's famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. These sites showcase some of the finest examples of Turkey's historical and natural heritage.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 1 Week Turkey Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 1 Week Turkey Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
